description.value: JOEY Burnaby is an upscale-casual chain restaurant in Burnaby's Brentwood neighbourhood, built around modern interiors with handmade lighting and a rooftop patio. Part of the family-owned JOEY Restaurants group operating since 1992, this location serves a globally inspired menu alongside handcrafted cocktails and maintains a dedicated private event space. The restaurant is wheelchair accessible and offers both indoor and outdoor patio seating.
